decisions.reason: Garage door operators are a core complement to the firm's garage-door systems, so management would more likely update the range than exit it.

As a niche solid-wood variant outside the firm's main metal-based, technology-oriented portfolio, it is the strongest candidate to release resources for higher-volume core products and new development.
The glazed insulated industrial sectional door fits the firm's compliance, thermal-performance and industrial-building positioning, which makes continued support more likely than withdrawal.
Despite some overlap risk and weaker energy-performance positioning than insulated versions, a glazed industrial sectional door still helps the firm offer a broad one-stop industrial door range.
